component.name: timeglance
component.summary: A printable weekly routine sheet and a year-at-a-glance planner

description.p: timeglance renders two config-driven planners from a simple YAML schedule: a printable weekly routine sheet and a year-at-a-glance calendar, each to PDF, PNG and SVG.

A web control panel ties them together with live previews, and on KDE Plasma it can set the rendered sheet as a per-screen desktop wallpaper. The system tray controller runs the control panel and the scheduled render in the background.
